construction: captured with ShroudForge's own mod runtime (a local differential test, not published): actual pinned ShroudForge mod-runtime, game-free private copies, release Windows x64 builds under headless Wine. No source checkout was edited or built in. Each oracle output matched its shared sfi-core transcript host byte-for-byte.
scope: Independent standard FNV-1a32, permissive crc 3.4.0, GUID public mixed-endian byte contract and synthetic observations only. All four returned u32 fields, ordinary table identity/mutability, ignored trailing valid UTF-8, strict hexadecimal characters, binary hashing and v2 errors are observed on both pins. Arbitrary userdata field getters/borrow conflicts, read-only Buffer state and per-owner registrar coexistence are additionally source-derived host tests; not seeded-oracle observations. No engine, archive, native bridge or reflected Resource/Content semantics are claimed.
